description.en: The first single from “Season One”, with an official video on the Folk's Worst Nightmare channel.

tracks.title: Jumping just to fall
tracks.lyrics: I’m a princess tonight. And I’m sure you heard about it. Silence down, my ears need to ring tonight from the fucked sound of the show. Stumble through the audience with much too much margarita in my hair. Don’t ... show more care about our future and lie about our past, this night again at last, we’re all one fine mess. A punk show somewhere else with all my closest pals. Jumping just to fall into each other’s arms. I wanna set my shoes on fire just to be the hottest dancer tonight. I wanna put my tongue in Liam just to make another homosexual experience. Peter shared amnesia, made us high like a mountain. Now the band’s playing their final song. One last time we fall in love with the chorus until we’re all stage diving home. A punk show somewhere else with all my closest pals. Jumping just to fall into each other’s arms.
